_help: Everything the home page says, in English. `node scripts/build-site.mjs` turns this (plus projects.json, photos.json, resume.json) into index.html, /resume/, /shell, the search index, i18n/index.en.json and the profile bios. See README → Editing the site.
name: Blaine Miller
_mode_help: Which face the home page shows first: "maker" (I'm building cool things) or "hire" (resume-forward). Visitors can switch; wemiller.com/hire always opens hire mode.
_openToWork_help: true shows the 'Open to senior & principal roles' badge in hire mode.
_domains_help: If one of these hostnames ever serves this site directly it opens in that view. Redirects to /?v=120 and /?v=luma keep working either way.
_tints_help: Glow colour of each featured card. Optional.
_contingency_help: The contingency plan's calendar, in days since the last heartbeat (docs/CONTINGENCY.md). ownerNudgeDays: when the owner is asked if he is there. quietDays: when the trusted people are told (nothing public). publicDays: when they are asked to confirm. confirmationsNeeded: how many must agree. reminderEveryDays, waitDays: how often they are reminded, and how long one of them can make everyone wait. state is "normal" or "contingency"; the daily run sets it when enough people have confirmed, and any heartbeat sets it back.
_luma_help: Luma's birthday. Through October her view counts down to the 22nd, then celebrates. When the day comes, set passed to that date (YYYY-MM-DD): her view becomes a memorial and the countdown stops. Preview: node scripts/build-site.mjs --luma-passed 2035-01-01. Celebrate her birthday after the fact with /?when=luma, or any day with /?v=luma&when=2027-10-22.
_future_help: What the time machine shows when a visitor travels forward. founderFrom: from this date the site reads as carried on by others, with a founder note in place of the hero. dogs: each dog lives about lifespan years and the next one arrives when the current one is adoptAt years old; names are stand-ins used in order. When a real dog joins, add { "name": "…", "born": "YYYY-MM-DD" } to real (and "passed" when the day comes): real dogs replace the stand-ins from that point. Luma is taken from luma above.
_seasons_help: Date-based celebrations in the hero (never in the Work view). First match wins, so the single days sit above the months they fall in. from/to are MM-DD; date is one exact day (YYYY-MM-DD), for a year that deserves its own line; rule easter/memorial are worked out each year, with days before/after. effect: snow, leaves, fireflies, embers, petals, stars, confetti, fireworks. greet shows the season.<id> string, only on the day itself (day, or the computed day for a rule, or every day of a one-day range). colors overrides the palette of an effect (repeat a colour to make it more likely). lights strings Christmas lights across the top and runs a light show. day is where the time machine lands when a range spans more than one day. Visitors reach any day through the time machine in the footer, or a link: /?when=christmas, /?when=luma, /?when=2026-12-25.

contact._help: Never plain text. Encode a value with: node scripts/build-site.mjs --encode 'mailto:you@example.com'

bios.tagline: I build what's missing, the way it should have been.
bios.short: Senior software engineer. {apps} apps shipped, many of them free and open source. I also photograph the night sky.
bios.medium: Senior software engineer: real-time data platforms and Kubernetes by day, {apps} shipped apps by night — a private social network with no servers, phone VR, a home-network guardian. I also photograph the night sky.
bios.long: I build what's missing, the way it should have been. {years}+ years as a software engineer across real-time data platforms, infrastructure and mobile, and {apps} apps shipped on my own: Haven, a private post-quantum social network with no servers; Afterglow, open-source phone VR; Enter Space, cloud storage that feels local; Shepherd, a self-hosted home-network guardian. Much of it is free and open source. Away from the keyboard I photograph the night sky, giant sequoias and a very fluffy dog named Luma.

strings.fut.founder.p: Blaine Miller started all of this in 2012: apps built the way they should have been, photographs of dark skies, and always a dog nearby. He isn't the one writing here anymore. What he began is kept going by the people who came after him, and it is still headed for tomorrow.
